title: Khaznah Priority 1 final correction assets
status: Corrections completed and checked. Ready for the user’s final visual approval before integration.
generation_method: Built-in image_gen for background patches in A3, A4 and A6 only; deterministic Pillow/NumPy compositing and alpha cleanup under explicit user authorization.
resolution_disclosure: Actual delivered sizes are listed below. The original brief’s 4800x1200/2400x2400/1600-high targets were not attained natively. The accepted exports have not been stretched or upscaled. 2508x627 is the final extended composite canvas, not a single native model output.
color: Original RGB/RGBA samples preserved. Files are untagged; intended for sRGB web display. No ICC conversion or color grading applied.

responsive_crop_guidance.coordinates: Zero-based [left, top, right, bottom]; right and bottom exclusive. Guidance for developer integration, not application code.

desktop_all_panoramas.note: The full primary products remain visible in these inspected crops. Peripheral plants, shelving tops and side-table context may be cropped.

A3.note: Use a right-biased photo crop. Put copy outside the strip when narrow; dock the price pin if needed.

A4.note: Use a left-biased photo crop. Put Arabic copy outside the strip when narrow; dock the price pin if needed.

A5.note: These light central trims retain the lower floor clearance. Avoid aggressive vertical zoom.

A6.note: Use A6 near 4:1. Below approximately 3.33:1, switch to A7 or display A6 uncropped with content outside it. A 2.4:1 centre cover crop cannot retain products at both sides; do not use that crop.

A7.note: Use the full portrait source with minimal trimming; its 992:1586 ratio is approximately 5:8.
